_comment: COPY THIS FILE to config.json and add your keys. Only the Anthropic key is REQUIRED — it powers TARS's brain (chat + mission debriefs). Everything else is optional and unlocks extra powers. Never paste keys in chat.

model._comment: REQUIRED. Get a key at console.anthropic.com. Opus 4.8 = best personality; claude-sonnet-5 = cheaper.

elevenlabs._voice: OPTIONAL premium voice. Without a key TARS speaks with your browser's free built-in voice. Default voice: Roger (deadpan American male) — or pick any voice from your ElevenLabs library.
elevenlabs._expressive: Used automatically when TARS's line contains [sighs]-style audio tags (humor >= 75). Falls back to model_id if unavailable.

openai._comment: OPTIONAL but recommended — powers the 📡 LIVE call (real-time voice conversation with screen sharing, ~300ms latency) and high-accuracy dictation. Get a key at platform.openai.com.

takeover._comment: TAKEOVER mode brains: fast (Haiku — quickest) / balanced (Sonnet — recommended) / smart (Opus — most careful). Also switchable in ⚙ SETTINGS.

hue._comment: OPTIONAL Philips Hue — room glows amber when TARS speaks, red flash on failed jobs. {"bridge_ip": "192.168.x.x", "app_key": "...", "lights": ["1","2"]}

picovoice._comment: OPTIONAL trained 'Hey TARS' wake word (scaffold — see DUPLEX.md bottom). Free key at console.picovoice.ai; train a Porcupine keyword, export Web WASM (.ppn) into static/.
